title: Selection and design of diamond core drills - Code of practice, Part 2: Top Drive Hydraulic
clause_1_scope: This standard ( Part 2 ) covers selection and design criterion for diamond core drills generally used for: a) Exploration of all minerals including coal; b) Mining and other allied drilling jobs including drifting and tunneling; and c) Investigations connected with foundation testing, grout drilling soil and strata investigations.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Steel Wire Ropes for General Engineering Purpose — Specification ( Fifth Revision )

clause_3_terminology: Selection and design of diamond core drills

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
